answer_1.quote: STEER-BENCH includes 30 contrasting subreddit pairs across 19 domains, from which we curated over 10,000 open-ended question-answer pairs... The benchmark also features a set of multiple-choice questions... to provide high-quality ground truth for alignment evaluation.
answer_1.outputs: Community-aligned responses to instructions and multiple-choice answers

answer_2.quote: We measure the accuracy as the proportion of model responses that match the silver labels.
